careers.title: AI/ML Engineering
careers.summary: AI/ML Engineering helps build systems that learn from data and make useful predictions or decisions.

careers.title: Cybersecurity
careers.summary: Protect computer systems, networks, people, and personal data from digital threats.

careers.title: Data Careers
careers.summary: Build practical data skills through one focused learning track, consistent practice, and one or two portfolio projects.

careers.title: Cloud Computing (AWS)
careers.summary: Learn cloud concepts and AWS services, deploy real projects, document architecture and security decisions, and optionally pursue entry-level certification.

careers.title: Full Stack Web Development
careers.summary: Build complete web applications end-to-end by learning front-end interfaces, back-end APIs, databases, version control, and deployment.

careers.title: Intro to Coding
careers.summary: A four-week beginner track for learning programming fundamentals with JavaScript and browser-based tools, then sharing a small portfolio of projects.

careers.title: Quantum Computing
careers.summary: Explore quantum information and computation by learning core concepts, building circuits, and testing small simulations with tools such as Qiskit.

careers.title: AI Safety, Alignment and Governance
careers.summary: Study how to make AI systems more reliable, controllable, accountable, and beneficial, spanning technical alignment, evaluations, governance, and responsible deployment.

careers.title: Project Management, Agile and Workflow Automation
careers.summary: Learn to define project scope, coordinate stakeholders, manage time and risks, run iterative delivery, and automate repeatable workflows using project-management tools.
